name: Fruition
source:
Yun wants a calm day in the woods to get away from it all. Little do they know, they're walking straight into a deal centuries in the making. And they are unfortunately less of a player and more of a piece.

[From [URL=https://garbledmess.itch.io/fruition]Itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
Yun只想暂时抛开一切，在树林里安静地待上一天，却不知道自己正一步步走进一场酝酿了几个世纪的交易。更不幸的是，Yun与其说是棋手，不如说是棋子。

[摘自[URL=https://garbledmess.itch.io/fruition]itch.io[/URL]]
